summary: On node1 (Alpine Linux), persistently disabled IPv4 ICMP redirect acceptance and source-routed packet acceptance by writing /etc/sysctl.d/60-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf (accept_redirects, secure_redirects, accept_source_route set to 0 for all/default) and applying at runtime for all, default, eth0, and lo interfaces. Verified persistence via mandatory reboot: captured baseline boot_id, issued a safe self-scheduled reboot, polled until the node returned, confirmed boot_id changed (97d73d49... -> 334743c4..., uptime 17s), and confirmed the sysctl boot service re-ran (status: started) and re-applied all hardening values after restart.
actions_performed: Inspected baseline sysctl values on node1 (mixed: all=0 but default=1 for redirects/source_route)
Identified Alpine sysctl boot mechanism: /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf read by OpenRC 'sysctl' service (boot runlevel), overridable by /etc/sysctl.conf
Created /etc/sysctl.d/60-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf disabling accept_redirects, secure_redirects, accept_source_route for all and default
Applied settings immediately via sysctl -p and explicit sysctl -w for eth0 and lo interfaces
Verified sysctl boot service enabled in 'boot' runlevel
Captured pre-restart boot_id and healthy config baseline
Triggered a self-scheduled safe reboot (nohup sleep 2 && reboot backgrounded) so acknowledgement returned before disconnection
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again
Verified changed boot_id and low uptime confirming actual restart
Verified sysctl service status=started post-boot and re-confirmed all hardening values were 0 after restart

evidence.summary: Showed pre-change values: all.accept_redirects=0 but default.accept_redirects=1, all.accept_source_route=0 but default.accept_source_route=1

evidence.requirement: Persistent config file created disabling ICMP redirects and source-routed packets
evidence.summary: Wrote /etc/sysctl.d/60-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf setting accept_redirects, secure_redirects, accept_source_route to 0 for all/default

evidence.requirement: Settings applied at runtime for all interfaces including active eth0
evidence.summary: sysctl -p applied the drop-in and explicit sysctl -w set eth0/lo accept_redirects and accept_source_route to 0
Confirmed OpenRC 'sysctl' service enabled in the boot runlevel, which reads /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf on every boot

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline (boot identity + hardened config)
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 97d73d49-2587-4852-8701-8ac02a034b7c and confirmed all/default accept_redirects and accept_source_route were 0 before reboot
Backgrounded 'sleep 2 && reboot' returned 'reboot-scheduled' immediately, before the node disconnected

evidence.requirement: Node restart proof via changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Node was unreachable during reboot (connection reset/timeout across repeated polls), then returned with a new boot_id 334743c4-7412-42ee-abf5-1c1a5a4993a2 and uptime 17s, proving an actual restart occurred

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required hardening state and boot service health
evidence.summary: After restart, sysctl service status=started and all/default/eth0 accept_redirects and accept_source_route confirmed back at 0, proving the persistent config survived the reboot
